verdicts.strongest_argument: The characterisation of Form 425 as 'the least-read filing type there is' inverts what the form actually is. A Form 425 is a filing OF a public communication about a business combination - a press release, an investor presentation, a shareholder letter - made under Rule 425 precisely because the issuer has already disseminated it publicly. Filing one is evidence of broad publication, not of obscurity. And the finding's own second piece of evidence is stronger still: a notice of meeting and proxy materials distributed to shareholders on 2026-08-24 is the most widely delivered document a company produces, sent to every holder of record. So a registered transaction requiring a shareholder vote is not a hidden fact in this name; it is the fact every holder has been mailed. That this capture contains no news coverage of it reflects n_queries=0 and a three-message social stream, which is a capture artefact I am instructed not to read as a concession. Where the finding is right, and genuinely useful, is on magnitude rather than direction - and the tape already says it. The baseline's eight matched events have a median absolute move of 0.82% and a maximum of 1.53%, run_up_20d is -0.41% and run_up_5d -2.68% with realised_vol_20d of 30.9%: this is a stock whose price is being set by exchange terms, exactly as the finding argues, and that compression is visible in the bars rather than waiting to be discovered. A magnitude observation that the baseline already encodes cannot be an edge, though it correctly warns against ranking this name on the median.
